rules.name: Overvoltage Circuit Trip
rules.description: Disconnect BESS if cell voltage exceeds 4.35V.

rules.name: Undervoltage Circuit Trip
rules.description: Disconnect BESS if cell voltage falls below 2.50V.

rules.name: Fire Suppression Trigger
rules.description: Activate clean-agent fire suppression system and isolate battery container from the grid when cell temperature hits 65C.
